description: This file defines a database migration class for version 5.2.0 of OrangeHRM, handling schema updates, data insertion, deletion, and configuration adjustments during the upgrade process.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class to manage database schema and data migrations for OrangeHRM version 5.2.0.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration steps including schema changes, data updates, and configuration cleanup.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of this migration, '5.2.0'.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of LangStringHelper associated with this migration.

methods.name: updatePimLeftMenuConfigurators
methods.description: Updates the left menu configuration for the PIM module.

methods.name: updateOrganizationStructure
methods.description: Updates organization structure data based on organization info.

methods.name: updateHomePage
methods.description: Updates the homepage URL for a given user role.

methods.name: insertLDAPMenuItem
methods.description: Inserts LDAP configuration menu item into the menu structure.

methods.name: cleanLDAPAddonData
methods.description: Deletes existing LDAP configuration and related module data.

methods.name: insertLangStringNotes
methods.description: Imports language string notes from a YAML file and updates database records.

methods.name: cleanI18nGroups
methods.description: Removes specific internationalization groups and updates related language strings.
